Transparent scoring

How the score is calculated

The dashboard now uses the InVEST Habitat Quality framework. Threat degradation accounts for relative threat weight, spatial effect, accessibility or protection, and habitat sensitivity.

Qxj = Hj × [1 − Dxjz / (Dxjz + kz)]
Riskxj = 1 − Qxj

Prototype parameters: z = 2.5 and k = 0.5. InVEST fixes z at 2.5; k, threat weights, distances, suitability, and sensitivity must be calibrated for the study area.

Read the official InVEST Habitat Quality documentation

Appropriate use: preliminary screening and prioritization. This tool does not replace field surveys, expert ecological review, or regulatory assessment.
